# DeskMock

> An open-source, MIT-licensed, local-first toolkit for the whole job search. It runs on
> your own machine against your own LLM API key — there is no SaaS, no account, and no
> telemetry. Your voice never leaves the machine; only text reaches a model, and pointing
> it at a local endpoint (Ollama, vLLM) means nothing leaves at all.

Site: https://deskmock.com
Source: https://github.com/sundarshankar/deskmock
Licence: MIT

## What it is

Two tools in one repository:

- **DeskMock** — a CLI mock interviewer. It reads a question aloud with macOS `say`, you
  speak your answer through a local dictation tool (on-device speech-to-text), and an
  OpenAI-compatible model plays a rigorous interviewer, coaches the answer, and moves on.
  It loops, then produces a scorecard. No cloud voice service, no LiveKit, no GPU.
- **JobHelm** — a local dashboard for the pipeline behind the interview: a Kanban board of
  every application by stage, discovery of new postings filtered to your own profile,
  truthful résumé tailoring, interview prep across leadership/technical/behavioural
  dimensions, follow-up cadence, and salary-negotiation prep.

## What makes it different

- **Local-first by construction, not by policy.** There is no server to send anything to.
- **Truthful by design.** Résumé tailoring reframes what the CV actually says and refuses
  to import a claim from the job description that the CV does not support; generated
  material reports which figures it could not trace back to the source CV.
- **It never submits an application.** Assisted autofill fills identity fields in your own
  browser tab and leaves work authorisation, sponsorship and salary alone, then reports
  every required field it did not touch. A human reviews and submits.

## Who it is for

People running a serious job search who would rather own their data than rent it: anyone
uncomfortable uploading a CV, a salary expectation and an interview transcript to a
third-party service, and anyone who wants the search to survive the tool's business model.

## Setup, in short

    git clone https://github.com/sundarshankar/deskmock
    export OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-your-key    # or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
    ./deskmock                                  # the mock interviewer
    python3 jobhelm/mission-control.py          # the dashboard, at 127.0.0.1:8899

Requires Python 3 and macOS for spoken questions; the dashboard runs anywhere Python does.
